summary: Loman AI is an AI phone-answering and ordering agent for restaurants that takes full menu orders, processes payments, books reservations, and pushes tickets directly into the restaurant's POS/KDS; it lists direct POS integrations with Toast, Square, Clover, Aloha, Olo, and Stream.

Loman AI publishes a three-tier pricing structure — Starter (basic call handling), Premium (adds ordering, reservations, POS integration, phone payments), and Enterprise (custom) — and states it charges 'no per-minute fees,' differentiating from usage-based competitors.

Loman AI claims restaurants using its product see, on average, a 26% increase in phone-order revenue and a 23% higher average ticket size, plus 99.6% order accuracy which it describes as industry-best. (Scope note: These are vendor-reported aggregate statistics without an independent audit or named source restaurants; treat as marketing claims, not verified operator ROI.)
